name: std::flat_multimap<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::max_size
intro: Returns the maximum number of elements the container is able to hold due to system or library implementation limitations. Equivalent to std::min<size_type>(c.keys.max_size(), c.values.max_size()).

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This value typically reflects the theoretical limit on the size of the container, at most std::numeric_limits<difference_type>::max(). At runtime, the size of the container may be limited to a value smaller than max_size() by the amount of RAM available.

examples.output: Maximum size of a std::flat_multimap is 768,614,336,404,564,650
